Deploying untrained, unqualified, and unaccountable agents to sweep through our communities and spread fear is not a public safety strategy. It undermines trust between law enforcement and the people they serve.

We do not have to choose between holding violent offenders accountable and protecting constitutional rights. In Maryland, we can and will do both.
